doubts.q: This page (13946 ids, Oct 2026) and Chat + Artifacts 'canvas-comments' (1969 ids, older) both design comments on an artifact canvas. Are they two halves of one flow (hover/select/compose there -> bubbles, thread menu, all comments, comment-in-chat here), or is this page a newer version that replaces canvas-comments? (Whether the bubbles here are instances of the same 'Canvas-Comments-Bouble' component 1902:350642 was not checked: the bridge dropped.)
doubts.proposedDefault: Two halves of one flow: keep canvas-comments for hover/select/compose, use this page for bubbles, the thread menu, all comments and comment-in-chat; where bubble states differ, the ones on this page (newer) win.
